name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
steps: Stand tall holding a single dumbbell in one hand by your side.
Brace your core strongly to keep your shoulders and hips completely level, resisting the pull of the weight.
Walk forward slowly in a straight line, keeping your torso completely upright.
Prevent your body from leaning toward the weighted side or over-compensating by leaning away.
Turn around smoothly, switch the dumbbell to the opposite hand, and repeat.
coaching_cues: Imagine your torso is walking between two narrow panes of glass.
Keep your shoulders square and avoid hiking up the opposite shoulder.
Walk with calm, deliberate, controlled heel-to-toe steps.
